title: Member calendar
slide_intent: Coordinate a cover identity with dense scheduling information because recognition must survive the transition from promotion to practical reading.
strategic_value: The W cover and bold date structure can connect Whitney’s membership communication to a useful calendar.
demonstration: A closed member calendar, an open editorial spread and a tall June–July 2013 calendar are arranged on gray.
practical_value: Compare brand presence on the cover with the typographic hierarchy needed for dates, events and accompanying images.

content_islands.name: Cover
content_islands.spec: Place the narrow W-led cover at upper left.

content_islands.name: Editorial spread
content_islands.spec: Show the open spread below with headings, columns and small photographs.

content_islands.name: Calendar
content_islands.spec: Place the tall two-month date grid at right with event information and images beside it.

reference_purposes.Application: The official launch caption identifies the calendar as material for the membership program.
